checkPendingTasks.description: Start the pipeline executions waiting in pending, such as rows inserted by SQL

steps.message: Pending pipelines checked: those that can start now have been started

putSchemaEvent.description: Save the pasted schema event to the schema triggers folder; the server names the file

steps.message: Schema event saved to the schema triggers folder

getRunManifest.description: Copy the selected run's manifest from the stage to the clipboard

value.literal: There is no manifest for this run: one is written only when a cpipes run completes.

getSchemaEvent.description: Copy the schema event of the selected run's input registration to the clipboard

deleteSessions.description: List the selected sessions and every session reading them, confirm, and queue their deletion

steps.message: Delete these sessions? Their rows are deleted from the database, the sessions reading them included; their files on S3 are kept, and a later lookback read skips them. This cannot be undone.

steps.onConflict: The sessions to delete changed since they were listed. Select Delete again to review them.

steps.message: Deletion queued: the sessions show as pending until they are deleted, and a session with a run still active waits for it to end
